payload.text: ATC Automation | Where Precision Meets Imagination Skip to Content Where Precision Meets Imagination and Your Success Sets the Standard At ATC, we deliver more than just equipment; we provide end-to-end support for custom automated systems. From the initial design conversation to final production support, we are dedicated to your operational success Learn More The Future of Automated Assembly We engineer and construct high-performance automated systems tailored to your specific production goals. Whether you require precision testing or heavy-duty assembly, our solutions leverage cutting-edge robotics, vision technology, data management, and more to drive efficiency at scale. Learn More Why We Serve Since 1977, we have served as a stable partner for manufacturers across diverse industries. Our unique operational model assigns a devoted team to your project, ensuring consistent communication and deep technical understanding from the kickoff meeting through final installation. Learn More Who We Serve Manufacturing challenges vary by industry, so we do not use a “one-size-fits-all” approach. We have organized our company into three specialized divisions, allowing our experts to master the specific compliance standards and technical demands unique to your market. Learn More How We Serve With our headquarters in Cookeville, Tennessee, and our secondary campus in Simi Valley, California, our coast-to-coast presence ensures we serve partners efficiently nationwide. Learn More Our Divisions General Industry Learn More General Industry Our general industry division caters to high-demand sectors like automotive and energy storage. We deliver robust automation solutions for everything from electric vehicle powertrains and battery storage to critical aircraft components. Learn More Consumer Product Learn More Consumer Product We understand the unique pressures of consumer products: rapid design changes, strict regulatory mandates, and the need for reliable production. We build systems that allow you to stay competitive by meeting these intense demands without sacrificing consistency or compliance. Learn More Life Science Learn More Life Science When patient safety is on the line, there is no room for error. We specialize in fully validated automation for medical devices and pharmaceuticals, treating regulatory compliance as a non-negotiable priority throughout the build. Learn More What If You Could See Your Machine Run Before It’s Built? That’s Where Our Simulation Team Comes In With ATC’s virtual commissioning capabilities, we eliminate the guesswork by building a fully interactive digital version of your machine. This allows us to test and refine the system’s logic weeks or months before the physical equipment is ever assembled. Mitigate Project Risk By simulating the system digitally, we can verify cycle rates, ergonomics, and recovery sequences early. This “digital rehearsal” ensures we are aligned on performance before the physical build, preventing co… [/about] About Us: The ATC Automation Story | ATC Automation About Us About Us: The ATC Automation Story | ATC Automation Skip to Content Driven by People, Defined by Partnership About Us The ATC Automation Story The ATC Automation Story Since our inception in 1977, ATC has evolved from a specialized precision fixture and tooling shop into a leader in custom automation solutions for customers in North America and beyond. Our journey is defined by a commitment to becoming an indispensable partner for our clients, moving beyond the role of a traditional equipment vendor. Originally known as the Automation Tool and Engineering Company , we have spent decades navigating the complexities of the industrial landscape, engineering solutions where precision meets innovation. Today, ATC is proud to be a part of TASI Test and Automation, a globally diversified group providing advanced assembly, test, and inspection solutions to several thousand customers worldwide. Our Evolution: From Precision Roots to Global Impact Our Evolution: From Precision Roots to Global Impact The early years of ATC were characterized by a vision to revolutionize manufacturing through precision fixtures, tooling, and small-scale machinery. As our expertise grew, our capabilities transformed into designing and building custom automation systems to meet the diverse needs of prominent global companies. A significant milestone in this growth was the 2021 acquisition of Dynamic Automation & Robotics in Simi Valley, CA, which has since been fully integrated into the ATC brand, expanding our physical presence and enriching our technical expertise. Dedicated Divisions: Gain Access to Specialized Expertise To ensure our clients work with teams that truly understand their unique market pressures, we have formalized our structure into three core divisions: Life Science Division Life Science Division Developed to address the fundamental truth that life-critical products require specialized quality and regulatory focus. We provide structured, audit-ready validation and long-term partnership throughout clinical trials and funding cycles. Learn More Consumer Product Division Consumer Product Division Built to support the future of domestic manufacturing by focusing on design agility, cost pressures, and reliable production. Learn More General Industry General Industry Leveraging our deep foundation in automotive and industrial sectors to drive innovation in high-growth markets like Electric Vehicles (EV) and Energy Storage. Learn More Our Approach to Custom Automation ATC’s approach is rooted in close collaboration and precision, treating every project as a true partnership rather than a transaction. Each opportunity begins with in-depth discussions to understand the underlying goals, constraints, and manufacturing realities driving the project.
